subject: Best way to handle upload of large data files?

messages.author: 85435c7e2689700c
messages.subject: Best way to handle upload of large data files?
parts:
Hi

I'm currently switching an RGtk2 app over to shiny. The main part of the app is to facilitate an analysis pipeline. The datafiles that gets analysed are rather large (500 mb+) so uploading them is rather time-consuming, especially as they are already available to R if you are running the app locally.

The question is thus how to best handle this scenario? My wish list is:

  • Have a graphic file selecter as with <input type='file'/>
  • Avoid copying the file to a temporary location if already available (app running locally)
  • Fallback to uploading if the file is not available (app running on server)

Is this possible at all? For the sake of user-friendliness I would really like to avoid having users type in the file path manually in a text field...

best

Thomas
